title: Speaking-Practice Frequency
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speaking:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes, count as sessions by _time
| eval enough=if(minutes>=60,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how much you actually speak the language each week, the skill most learners neglect.
value: Output practice lags input for most learners; a weekly speaking total nudges you to actually use the language.
implementation: Ingest speaking sessions into `index=personal`; total weekly speaking minutes.
visualization: Column chart of weekly speaking-practice minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much you actually speak the language each week, the part most learners skip.
